purpose: Test the user's hypothesis that the L30 Update intervention is behaviorally too late, using the identical ten primary inputs and the frozen item-span kernel.
classification: Exploratory layer comparison requested after all N10 primary outcomes; keep N10 L30 selection and results.
layer_panel_rationale: Fixed six-layer spacing from L1 through L25, plus primary L30 and the last layer L35 retaining a subsequent K/V write; no additional adaptive scan.
seeds: All ten frozen Qwen Index primary Update seeds; no success-based selection or new baseline generation.
smoke: First frozen seed at all six new layers, both directions, all three conditions; check geometry, nonzero Target/zero self-native, finite scores, and raw/hook ordering. Do not require favorable outcomes.
primary_endpoint: First generated known city equals donor k+1; paired Target-minus-self within seed/layer/direction.
supporting_endpoints: Conditional and unconditional exact city-prefix continuation
interpretation: Earlier-layer success with L30 failure would support layer dependence on these reused inputs; it would not by itself identify the responsible Q/K/V pathway. Any subsequent layer choice requires a separately disclosed procedure and independent confirmation.
queue_policy: Use a new stage after completed N10 primary; never restart the superseded pre-N10 diagnostic. Verify GPU availability and do not interrupt active research jobs.
